accordion_sections.title: Where is Cadillac Casino located?
accordion_sections.content: Cadillac Casino is located at the DoubleTree by Hilton Goa, Panaji, Kadamba Plateau, Ribandar, Panaji, Goa, 403006, India. It is situated near the Mandovi River in the heart of Panaji.

accordion_sections.title: What kind of games are available at Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Cadillac Casino offers a variety of gaming options, including Roulette, Blackjack, Poker, Baccarat, and Slot Machines. It provides a luxurious setting for gaming enthusiasts.

accordion_sections.title: What are the timings for Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Cadillac Casino typically operates in the evening, with gaming hours from 7:00 PM to 3:00 AM. However, timings may vary, and it’s recommended to confirm with the casino for up-to-date information.

accordion_sections.title: Is there an entry fee to the casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, there is an entry fee at Cadillac Casino, which is typically required to access the gaming areas. The fee may vary depending on the time of year and any special events. Entry fees generally include gaming credits, drinks, and access to the casino’s facilities.

accordion_sections.title: Do I need to dress formally to visit Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Cadillac Casino has a smart-casual dress code. Visitors are expected to wear appropriate attire (no flip-flops, shorts, or sleeveless shirts). The casino provides a high-end gaming experience, so dressing well is recommended.

accordion_sections.title: Can I visit Cadillac Casino with children?
accordion_sections.content: Cadillac Casino is an adult-only venue, and children are not permitted in the gaming areas. However, the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel has family-friendly facilities, and there are many nearby attractions suitable for families.

accordion_sections.title: Are there dining options available at Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Cadillac Casino offers dining options, including Buffet meals and A la carte services. The casino's restaurants offer a range of international and local cuisines, including Goan specialties and fine dining experiences.

accordion_sections.title: What are the nearby attractions to Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Nearby attractions include: Miramar Beach: A peaceful beach located a short drive from the casino. Dona Paula: A scenic viewpoint with panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and Mandovi River. Chapora Fort: A historic fort with stunning views of the coast. Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa. River Cruises on the Mandovi River: Scenic boat rides close to the casino.

accordion_sections.title: Is parking available at Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, there is parking available for guests visiting Cadillac Casino at the DoubleTree by Hilton Goa, including valet parking services.

accordion_sections.title: Is there an age restriction to enter Cadillac Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, you must be 21 years or older to enter Cadillac Casino, in accordance with the legal gambling age in Goa.

Goa is famous for its vibrant nightlife, and its casinos are a major attraction for both domestic and international tourists. The state offers a unique blend of land-based and floating casinos, with the latter located on luxury boats along the Mandovi River. These casinos feature a variety of games such as roulette, blackjack, poker, and slot machines, providing an exciting experience for visitors looking to try their luck. Popular casinos like Deltin Royale, Casino Pride, and Big Daddy are known for their luxurious settings, live entertainment, and exquisite dining options. While the land-based casinos provide a lively atmosphere, the floating casinos offer an added allure with scenic river views. Goa’s casino scene is regulated, ensuring that they operate under strict rules, which further enhances the security and enjoyment of the guests. With its laid-back vibe, Goa offers a one-of-a-kind destination for both gaming enthusiasts and those seeking a glamorous, fun-filled experience.

The casino is housed on a floating ship, providing a unique and exciting environment for players. Panjim, the capital city of Goa, is home to several renowned casinos that offer a unique blend of gaming, entertainment, and luxury. These casinos, located on floating boats or in plush resorts, provide an exciting atmosphere for both tourists and locals.

Deltin Royale is one of the most luxurious and largest floating casinos in Goa, located on the Mandovi River in Panjim. The casino offers a wide variety of gaming options, including blackjack, poker, roulette, baccarat, and slot machines. With its high-end amenities, gourmet restaurants, and live entertainment, it’s a popular choice for both gaming enthusiasts and tourists looking for an upscale experience.

Casino Pride is another well-known casino in Panjim, offering a floating casino experience on the Mandovi River. It features a wide range of games, including poker, blackjack, roulette, and slot machines. The casino also offers luxurious dining options and a variety of entertainment, making it an ideal place for a fun-filled night out.

As an extension of the Casino Pride brand, Casino Pride 2 offers a more expansive space for gaming. It is also located on the Mandovi River and provides a variety of casino games along with bars, dining facilities, and live performances. This floating casino provides a similar experience to its sibling but with additional entertainment options and gaming tables.

Another casino from the Deltin group, Deltin Jaqk is situated on the Mandovi River. It offers a more intimate and relaxed gaming experience compared to Deltin Royale but still boasts a range of casino games such as poker, blackjack, and roulette. Deltin Jaqk is known for its lively atmosphere, top-notch service, and entertainment options.

Located in Panjim, Big Daddy Casino is one of the most popular land-based casinos in Goa. It offers a variety of games, including poker, roulette, blackjack, and a wide range of slot machines. Big Daddy also has a great reputation for its upscale services and is known for its lively ambiance and entertainment.

Situated in the Dona Paula area, near Panjim, The Chances Resort & Casino offers a more relaxed, resort-style atmosphere. In addition to the casino, the resort provides facilities such as a swimming pool, spa, and restaurants. It’s a great choice for those looking for a more laid-back gaming experience in Goa.

In Goa, several casinos offer a range of gaming experiences, including both onshore and offshore options. Offshore casinos are located on luxury cruise ships and are often the most popular, with the Deltin Royale and Casino Pride being among the top choices. Onshore casinos, like Casino Strike and Casino Carnival, are located in five-star hotels and resorts.

Just a short drive from Cadillac Casino, Miramar Beach is one of the closest beaches in Panaji. Known for its golden sands and relatively calm waters, it’s a perfect spot for a leisurely walk, sunset views, or a peaceful day at the beach.

A popular viewpoint and beach, Dona Paula offers scenic views of the Arabian Sea and the Mandovi River. The spot has a historical significance and is also home to the famous Dona Paula statue. It’s ideal for sightseeing and photography.

This charming old Latin Quarter in Panaji is a must-visit for history and culture enthusiasts. Strolling through the narrow, colorful streets gives a glimpse of Goa's colonial past, with its vibrant Portuguese-style houses, art galleries, and quaint cafés.

Located in Old Goa, a short drive from the casino, the Basilica of Bom Jesus is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Goa’s most famous landmarks. It houses the remains of St. Francis Xavier and is an important site for religious and historical significance.

Also located in Old Goa, the Se Cathedral is one of the largest churches in India and an excellent example of Portuguese-Gothic architecture. It’s a prominent attraction for visitors interested in Goan history and religious landmarks.

Situated across the Mandovi River from Panaji, Reis Magos Fort is one of the oldest forts in Goa. It offers panoramic views of the river and surrounding areas and provides insight into Goa's colonial past.

Just a few minutes away from Cadillac Casino, the Mandovi River offers scenic river cruises. These cruises provide a unique perspective of the Panaji coastline and are often accompanied by live Goan music and dance performances.

The Panaji Market is a great place for those interested in shopping for souvenirs, spices, and local handicrafts. It’s a lively, bustling market with a variety of products reflecting Goa's culture and traditions.

Located in Old Goa, the Church of St. Cajetan is another stunning example of Baroque architecture. Its calm surroundings make it a peaceful place to visit after exploring the more tourist-heavy spots in the area.
For a deeper dive into Goa’s history and culture, the Goa State Museum in Panaji offers a collection of artifacts, sculptures, and exhibits related to the state's art, culture, and history.
